unstuck_said.text: Filed Nano-settlement issue #1 on MarkovianProtocol/x402-second-measurement: "Count Nano (XNO) settlements as a second, honest measurement rail." Their whole method counts AuthorizationUsed events on Base with no indexer; a Nano send is the same kind of re-derivable public event with no gas subsidy, so a Nano settlement count is a cleaner read of organic demand.
